Do you enjoy working in a logistics environment and like having a variety of tasks?
For our client in Deurne, we are looking for motivated EPT Operators / Order Pickers.

After enjoying a cup of coffee or tea, you and your colleagues will start the workday. You will be responsible for a variety of tasks within the warehouse, including:

- Picking, checking, collecting, and preparing orders for shipment
- Wrapping and scanning pallets
- Moving goods and pallets using an EPT (Electric Pallet Truck)
- Lifting boxes weighing up to 23 kg
- Operating reach trucks, combi trucks, and forklifts

In addition, you may occasionally be assigned other warehouse-related tasks, such as applying stickers and labels, repacking products, inflating balls, and performing other general warehouse duties.

Who are you?

- You are flexible and do not mind working in a two-shift schedule.
- You live in the region of Deurne, Helmond, Weert, Venray, or Peel en Maas.
- You speak Dutch or English.

As a warehouse employee at DHL, you help sort parcels and make sure each parcel ends up in the right place. Thanks to your work, parcels are sorted on time and delivered to customers.

You can start by placing parcels onto the conveyor belt so they can be sorted, or by taking sorted parcels off the belt and placing them in a roll cage. Later, DHL gives you the opportunity to learn and carry out other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: parcels can weigh up to 25 kg. Most parcels are lighter, but heavier parcels sometimes occur. You always lift these together with a colleague.

Working Hours

- Day shift: 08:00–16:00
- Evening shift: 16:00–00:00
- Intermediate shift: 18:00–02:00
- Night shift: 00:00–08:00

You can work across a maximum of two different shifts.

- You are available at least 3 to 4 days per week.
- You can lift parcels weighing up to 25 kg, with a colleague’s help for heavier parcels.
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle or scooter), or you live within walking distance of the sorting centre.
- You speak Dutch or English so you can communicate effectively with your team.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- You live in or around Dordrecht, Rotterdam, Schiedam or Capelle aan den IJssel.

Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required. The candidate must be able to preach, teach, provide pastoral care, lead meetings, and supervise staff in an English speaking church environment.

Applicants should submit a CV and a cover letter explaining their relevant ministry experience and interest in serving Grace Church Amsterdam.
